description: This file is a benchmarking class for the Orleans TopK project, implementing performance tests for various data structures and algorithms related to frequency counting and sampling methods, including space-saving algorithms and Zipf distribution sampling.

classes.name: EdgeClass
classes.description: A simple record class wrapping an Edge instance used within the benchmarking context.

classes.name: EdgeFrequentItemCollection
classes.description: A specialized collection class for managing frequency of Edge elements with capacity limit.

classes.name: EdgeClassFrequentItemCollection
classes.description: A collection class for managing frequency of EdgeClass elements with capacity limit.

classes.name: UlongFrequentItemCollection
classes.description: A collection class for managing frequent ulong items with capacity.

classes.name: FrequencySink
classes.description: An implementation of the Space-Saving algorithm for top-k frequency estimation of edges.

classes.name: ZipfRejectionSampler
classes.description: A sampler for generating samples following the Zipf distribution using rejection sampling.

methods.name: GlobalSetup
methods.description: Initializes data for performance benchmarking, including sampling data and collections.

methods.name: IterationSetup
methods.description: Sets up state before each benchmark iteration; currently empty or commented out.

methods.name: FssAdd
methods.description: Benchmark method for adding samples to the EdgeFreqItemCollection.

methods.name: SinkAdd
methods.description: Benchmark method for adding samples to the FrequencySink.
